## Summary

Wrote `review.md` with verdict **CHANGES_REQUIRED**. Key finding: the PR frames itself as pure cleanup, but `base.py` silently removes four auth-mode-selector env vars from the headless subprocess strip list — reopening issues #879/#880 that this exact code was written to close (the "closes issues #879/#880" comment is left in place, now contradicted by the code below it). Also flagged: `flatline-orchestrator.sh` drops `mktemp` failure guards, turning a recoverable per-item skip into a full-process crash under `set -euo pipefail`; and `loa-status.sh` drops both the `NO_COLOR`/TTY check (leaking ANSI codes into piped/logged output) and unknown-flag validation (typos now silently swallowed instead of erroring).
